name: Adams Rite Electrified 8800EL Panic Hardware
description: The Adams Rite 8800EL Electric Latch Retraction Panic Hardware is the same as the 8800, but with an internal solenoid to retract the latch-bolt. This is a very popular device in the Hotel Industry and is usually used in conjunction with a card reader. The 8800 features the Starwheel locking bolt that interlocks door to the door frame. The 36" version is in stock, we can also get the 30", 42" and 48" devices, lead time is 2-3 weeks. This device is used exclusively on aluminum framed glass storefront doors. Replacement parts are available. To order specify your Door Width, Color or Finish, and Voltage (12 or 24 Volt).
